title: Reset Password
content: Users can reset their password by going to Settings, then Security, and selecting Reset Password. They will receive a verification email to confirm their identity.

title: Update Profile
content: Users can update their profile information from the Profile section. They can change their name, phone number, profile photo, and basic account details.

title: Subscription Plans
content: The platform offers Free, Pro, and Enterprise plans. The Free plan includes basic access, the Pro plan includes advanced features, and the Enterprise plan includes team management and priority support.

title: Refund Policy
content: Refunds are available within 7 days of purchase if the user has not heavily used the service. Refund requests can be submitted through the Billing section.

title: Data Privacy
content: User data is encrypted and stored securely. The platform does not sell personal data to third parties. Users can request data deletion from the Privacy Settings page.

title: Contact Support
content: Users can contact support through the Help Center by submitting a support ticket. Support usually replies within 24 to 48 hours.
